chunks: a warning has come to you from your Lord, a remedy for the (doubts) of the heart, and a guidance and grace for those who believe.
ai.seo_question: What are the four spiritual benefits of the Quran mentioned in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the Quran's dual nature as both a spiritual remedy for the diseases of the heart (such as doubt and hypocrisy) and a practical guide for conduct. The term 'healing' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as addressing both physical and spiritual ailments, emphasizing that its mercy is particularly effective for those who possess faith and understanding.

en.ahmedali: a warning has come to you from your Lord, a remedy for the (doubts) of the heart, and a guidance and grace for those who believe.
en.ahmedraza: The advice has come to you from your Lord and a cure for the hearts – and guidance and mercy for believers.
en.arberry: now there has come to you an admonition from your Lord, and a healing for what is in the breasts, and a guidance, and a mercy to the believers.
en.daryabadi: now there hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord and a healing for that which is in Your breasts, and a guidance and a mercy for the believers.
en.hilali: There has come to you a good advice from your Lord (i.e. the Quran, ordering all that is good and forbidding all that is evil), and a healing for that (disease of ignorance, doubt, hypocrisy and differences, etc.) in your breasts, - a guidance and a mercy (explaining lawful and unlawful things, etc.) for the believers.
en.itani: There has come to you advice from your Lord, and healing for what is in the hearts, and guidance and mercy for the believers.
en.maududi: Now there has come to you an exhortation from your Lord, a healing for the ailments of the hearts, and a guidance and mercy for those who believe.
en.mubarakpuri: There has come to you good advice from your Lord, and a cure for that which is in your breasts, -- a guidance and a mercy for the believers.
en.pickthall: There hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, a balm for that which is in the breasts, a guidance and a mercy for believers.
en.qarai: There has certainly come to you an advice from your Lord, and a cure for what is in the breasts, and a guidance and mercy for the faithful.
en.qaribullah: an admonition has now come to you from your Lord, and a healing for what is in the chests, a guide and a mercy to believers.
en.sahih: there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.
en.sarwar: good advice has come to you from your Lord a (spiritual) cure, a guide and a mercy for the believers.
en.shakir: there has come to you indeed an admonition from your Lord and a healing for what is in the breasts and a guidance and a mercy for the believers.
en.transliteration: qad jaatkum mawAAithatun min rabbikum washifaon lima fee alssudoori wahudan warahmatun lilmumineena
en.wahiduddin: There has come to you an admonition from your Lord, a cure for what is in the hearts, and a guide and a blessing to true believers.
en.yusufali: there hath come to you a direction from your Lord and a healing for the (diseases) in your hearts,- and for those who believe, a guidance and a Mercy.
